caption: The drawing depicts the façade of a mission-style building rendered in grayscale pencil on a light background. The main structure has a triangular pediment with three circular windows near the roofline and a clover-shaped detail centered above an arched doorway. The doorway is topped by a decorative arch supported by two columns and accessed via a broad, curved staircase that extends forward. A cross sits at the apex of the roof. Flanking the central building are two additional architectural elements: an arched opening to the left with a broken upper edge, and a matching arched passageway to the right with a vertical crack. Below the stairs is a banner with the date "1797" and the inscription "Mision Santa Margarita," accompanied by the initials "RC." The composition consists primarily of shades of black, gray, and white, with shaded areas indicating depth and texture.
title: Mision Santa Margarita
